reviews.text: Echoes of Mystralia was featured in the Future Games Show at gamescom 2024
Echoes of Mystralia is a great action-rpg roguelite where you crafts spells and take on never the same fight twice as you save the world's memories from consumption to prevent its destruction.

A fantastic "build-a-spell" action roguelike, with great combat, voiceover and a story that keeps you playing again and again. Very similar to "Hades" but with different lore and mechanics! Must PLAY!
combat feels so fluid along with combining spells is fast and is never locked in so you can try all sorts of combos when it comes to the spell crafting
Monke likes mixing spells and modifiers to create unique combinations. Worth 1.76 banana.
Guess what time it is...further down the Hall of Heroes and 20th century society meet and go back to the start with the legendary Echoes of Mystralia.
Secrets are out, get them while the master class is in. Social media will never be the right ending for the heroes and players alike. Of Course.

Incredible Rougelike where you build and combine spells to create new weapons. If you've ever played "Hades" then you'll love this a lot! The lore, mechanics, voiceacting and art is 10/10, can't wait!
